answers.critical: Critical stock view: Cuttack, Gajapati, Malkangiri, Deogarh, Nuapada, Jajapur, Kandhamal, and Nabarangpur need priority review. Suggested action is to dispatch available doses, verify LAC reporting, and prepare a district-wise stock transfer note.
answers.semen: Semen report summary: monitor stock, allocated doses, AI usage, target achievement, days to stockout, block coverage, and LAC reporting status. The master report can be exported with district, block, LAC, farmer, breed, and technician fields.
answers.farmer: Farmer AI service history: show farmer ID, animal tag, breed, parity, AI date, semen type, technician, repeat-service flag, pregnancy follow-up, and village coverage. This is ready for RAG search and Excel export.
answers.medicine: Medicine request summary: P0 and P1 requests should be routed to BVO approval, checked against stock availability, and tracked through dispatch status. Include medicine name, source LAC, urgency, quantity, and approval outcome.
answers.disease: Disease alert trend: combine vaccination due lists, reported symptoms, MVU visits, and block-level disease watch zones. Priority output should show alert severity, affected villages, and pending field action.
answers.graph: Graph insight: compare utilisation percentage against stock balance. Use bar charts for district performance and line charts for month-wise service trends. Highlight outliers with low stock and high service demand.
answers.download: Download-ready report: CSV/Excel export includes module, district, indicator, value, status, and recommended action. The same payload can be converted to PDF after backend integration.
